items.title: Traditional bond investors have lost money for years. These five-star portfolio managers show a better way.
items.content: A fixed-income team at Morgan Stanley say investing in distressed debt and frontier local-market investing have helped drive solid returns for their fund.

items.title: It might be time to consider the ‘most hated, under-owned asset class,’ says this strategist
items.content: Vincent Deluard, market strategist at StoneX, recommends pairing British equities with a trade that shorts the euro against the Japanese yen.

items.title: Factory robots long posed a safety threat to human workers. One company says it has solved that problem.
items.content: Ahead of an expected public-market debut later this year, Agility Robotics says it has cracked the code and devised humanoids that can work safely alongside real humans.

items.title: Jewelry sales are heating up as Gen Z seeks out ‘little treats’ and the ultra-rich go for chunky gold
items.content: A Kohl’s executive recently said fine jewelry “just seems to be something that continues to trend incredibly well with our customers.”

items.title: When people with student debt try to save for retirement, they fall behind early and never catch up
items.content: If all employers matched debt payments, workers would save more than $10 billion.

items.title: ‘There might be a silver lining’: My friend’s wife died at 60 after a high-earning career. Can he claim her Social Security?
items.content: “They had been married for over 30 years when she passed.”

items.title: Morgan Stanley joins Goldman Sachs in 11th-hour switch to predict a Fed hike
items.content: Morgan Stanley previously thought the Federal Open Market Committee would leave rates unchanged, but now thinks the U.S. central bank will hike interest rates.

items.title: The Fed may be on the verge of a serious mistake, prominent economists warn
items.content: Some economists are calling on the central bank to wait before raising interest rates, out of concern the economy may be vulnerable beneath the surface.

items.title: ‘He does not have a spouse or children’: My son has a serious genetic disease. What should I do with my $1.3 million estate?
items.content: “He is also the sole beneficiary of my 403(b) accounts.”

items.title: ‘My total balance should be $20 million’: I invested $1.1 million in a crypto platform. Have I lost it all?
items.content: “I invested on the recommendation of an executive vice president of a major New York investment bank.”
